rationale: The pain is structurally real and well-documented: AI-accelerated exploit timelines genuinely compress the response window for small teams. However, the proposed factory-buildable solution (a weekly AI-generated security digest) fails to clear the pain validation bar. It does not produce 5 distinct pain quotes from discoverable sources, the willingness-to-pay signal is indirect (incumbents like Snyk/Wiz serve this segment, but at a product depth far beyond what this factory can deliver), and the core differentiation—stack-specific CVE prioritization over free tools like Dependabot and free CVE newsletters—is unproven. The scoring system itself flags build-gate failures on buildability_with_ai and operational_autonomy. Advancing would risk a wasted build cycle on a watered-down product in a crowded category.
